# Provider v2 Checkpoint

## Current branch
- `rewrite/provider-v2`
- Baseline/reference: existing Provider implementation remains untouched.

## Architecture
Provider v2 is a clean native AniLab provider architecture. Do not blindly copy the old Provider or external CloudStream/OCE runtime.

### Current foundation
- `AniLabProvider`: search / load / loadLinks contract.
- `AniLabExtractor`: canHandle / extract contract.
- `AniLabStreamCandidate`: canonical stream candidate model.
- `AniLabExtractionContext`: referer, origin, user-agent, cookies, headers.
- `AniLabRouter`: Auto and Manual provider routing.
- `AniLabFailureType`: explicit failure classification.
- `AniLabCircuitBreaker`: provider health/cooldown foundation.
- `AniLabExtractorRegistry`: ordered extractor selection and failure collection.
- `AniLabCandidatePipeline`: provider candidates → extractor boundary.
- `AniLabStreamVerifier`: HTTP/media-type verification before Media3.
- `AniLabVerifiedCandidatePipeline`: extraction pipeline → verification.

### Routing rules
- AUTO: Provider A may fail, then try Provider B/C.
- MANUAL: stay on the selected provider; fallback only across its servers/extractors.
- Router returning a candidate does NOT mean playback is proven.
- Actual playability must be verified by integration/E2E through Media3 and `onRenderedFirstFrame()`.

## Validation rule
Never mark a checkpoint GREEN unless the relevant build/test actually passed.
A parser working is not equivalent to a playable stream.
A resolved URL is not equivalent to Media3 first-frame playback.
